subject: oop
question: Write a program showing one interface extending another.
title: Interface Extends Interface
hook: A full licence is the learner licence plus more. Interfaces can do that too.
answer: interface Pet extends Animal { void play(); }  (an interface extends an interface using the keyword extends, not implements; Pet now has eat() and play())
class Dog implements Pet { public void eat() {...} public void play() {...} }  (the class must implement every method in the whole chain, and keep them public)
main: Dog d = new Dog(); d.eat(); d.play();
